events.label: Carney designates Pacific Link pipeline project of national interest

slots.name: stay support
slots.sentence: An Ipsos poll last week found 70% back staying in Canada.

slots.name: US oil share
slots.sentence: “Today, 90% of Alberta’s oil goes to the United States,” he said.

slots.name: public funding
slots.sentence: The federal and Alberta governments are contributing roughly $2.8 billion before the main private investor, Pembina Pipeline Corp., has committed its share of the construction costs.

slots.name: Pembina interest
slots.sentence: Pembina holds a 10% economic interest and would decide whether to invest by the time a final investment decision is made, a federal official said.

slots.name: national interest status
slots.sentence: Carney designated the Pacific Link pipeline as a project of national interest under legislation his government enacted to accelerate major infrastructure projects.

slots.name: public vote date
slots.sentence: Alberta is holding a public vote on Oct. 19 on whether to hold a referendum on leaving Canada.
